$comment: Derived from FluffyTaill/astra-remote@v0.6.2. Digests are of the bytes the bot downloaded and the attestation covers. Ownership proved by: unrecorded.

client.reason: The phone app is a chat with Astra: what you type or say on the phone goes to Astra as if you typed it here.

fire_trigger.reason: The buttons on the phone run the Astra commands you hang on the "Phone Remote: button N" triggers.

send_chat_message.reason: Sends your messages from the phone to Astra and streams her reply back to the phone.
